Supply chain diagnostic

Turn an operating symptom into a decision you can defend.

A bounded 2–4 week review that reconstructs the real journey, tests root causes and prioritises the first 90 days of action.

Start when the symptoms are visible but the cause is disputed

OTIF is down, inventory is up, teams are expediting and every function has a different explanation. The diagnostic creates one evidence boundary and one accountable decision.

Common triggers

  • Service measures no longer match customer experience.
  • Inventory grows while availability remains volatile.
  • Supplier, planning and logistics data do not reconcile.
  • Management effort rises without a clear root-cause view.
  • A major system or network decision needs testing before capital is committed.
